claim_text: A coffee bean shortage caused by something happening to the bushes, with fires, drought and pest or environmental problems named as the possible cause.
quote: what causes the coffee bean shortage? Something happens
falsify_match: A global arabica shortage traced to crop disease, fire or drought, severe enough to close retail outlets.
falsify_miss: Supply stays adequate. Coffee prices had already hit record highs in 2025 on Brazilian drought, so the shortage he names was in the market news before the vision.

claim_text: Driving past a Starbucks he sees a vision of a shortage there and stores being shut down because of a problem with the beans.
quote: they were shutting down stores because there was a problem with the beans
falsify_match: Starbucks closing stores and citing bean supply.
falsify_miss: Store closures happen for lease and labour reasons without any supply cause. Starbucks had already announced hundreds of closures in 2024 and 2025 on other grounds.
